covered_operator_workflows: Meeting detail (/management/meetings/:id) in zh-TW and en-US displays previous decisions (PriorActionsSection) first, followed by adopted tasks (AdoptedActionsSection) and participant capability limits (ParticipantCapabilities), above the deliberation rounds

Each meeting action displays accountable owner, expected deliverable, acceptance criterion, due/review schedule, execution result, navigable evidence links (/management/artifacts/:id and /management/evidence?ref_id=:id), resolved evidence_notes body, review decision/reason, live owner status separate from frozen meeting state, and next step
Distinguishes round discussion (participant stance unchanged) from chair decision to retain the strategy pool (decision_kind=retain_pool), and submitted (awaiting chair review) from accepted

Distinguishes prior_actions owner unavailable (action_read.status=unavailable), permission denied (action_read.status=denied), partial/degraded page reads, and genuine zero prior obligations (legacy W47 records) even when prior_actions is an empty array []
Displays dispatch_pending action receipts truthfully with dispatch_error and no fake ticket link when ticket_id is null

Translates participant capability statuses (allowed, advisory_only, restricted_data, suspended, no_workflow, expired_access, downgraded_access, owner_unavailable) in plain language without leaking persona_id or persona_display_name when anonymised_labels_revealed=false

Human Inbox (/management/human-inbox and /management/human-inbox/:id) consumes verbatim BFF _human_input_ticket_items fields (response_action, can_respond, resumes_with, human_requirement, reason, requested_material, acceptance_criterion, required_actor, ticket_id, revision, status, evidence_refs, links.ticket, links.meeting)
Enforces authentic operator (can_respond=true) vs read-only viewer (can_respond=false) permissions while preserving direct-human requirement/reason separate from requested deliverable

Submits human response via canonical PATCH /api/v1/research/tickets/{ticket_id} with action (submit | provide_input), expected_revision, evidence_note, and Idempotency-Key (reused on same-content retry)

Reads back canonical GET /api/v1/research/tickets/{ticket_id} after PATCH and on reload after the ticket leaves the human_actionable=true inbox list, rendering updated ticket status and resolved evidence_notes body on the same ticket_id
